learning_objective: 🎯 We will observe our surroundings closely and draw our colorful neighborhood, school, and busy streets!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we look out the window, we see tall buildings, little houses, and busy roads. We can draw our neighborhood using big rectangles and long lines.
Things that are close to us look very big, like a tree next to our house. Things that are far away look super tiny, like birds high in the sky!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Beautiful Window View
fun_activity.instructions: Look out your favorite window at home. Draw exactly what you see outside! Is there a street, a big tree, or a sleeping dog?

quick_recap: ⭐ Looking around carefully helps us draw things exactly as they are.
⭐ Objects far away look tiny, and objects close to us look very big.
⭐ Drawing our neighborhood tells a beautiful story about where we live.
